oz.f: Abbreviation of ounce; any of various units of weight and volume.

s.g: (US, slang) An ounce (especially of marijuana or other drugs).
A member of a people of Ozark with a distinct culture, architecture, and dialect.
(sumo) A sumo wrestler ranking below yokozuna and above sekiwake; champion.

ozier.f: (now largely obsolete) Alternative form of osier.

s.g: (chemistry) The act of treating with ozone.
(chemistry) The act of converting into, or producing, ozone.
(inorganic chemistry) An allotrope of oxygen (symbol O₃) having three atoms in the molecule instead of the usual two; it is a toxic gas, generated from oxygen by electrical discharge.
(UK, informal) Fresh air, especially that breathed at the seaside and smelling of seaweed.
To treat or react with ozone; to ozonate
To convert oxygen into ozone, especially by using an ozonizer

ozonized.f: simple past and past participle of ozonize

s.g: (chemistry) Any reaction with ozone, especially to a double bond, in which cleavage of a bond occurs.
A person once famous and respected who has since been utterly forgotten.
